title: A Gravitational Battle Within the Earth Is Changing the Length of Days
gist: A new Nature study proposes that gravitational coupling between Earth's misaligned inner core and mantle mass irregularities, opposed by other core-mantle interactions, drives decades-scale speedups and slowdowns in Earth's rotation; the model reproduced the timing and magnitude of observed length-of-day changes from 1964 to 2019.
